title: Payhawk Deploys Flagright for Real-Time Transaction Monitoring
summary: Payhawk selects Flagright to extend real-time transaction monitoring and watchlist screening across its global spend platform, unifying fraud and AML controls across cards, accounts, and payments.
body_markdown:
Flagright, the AI operating system for financial crime compliance, today announced that Payhawk has selected Flagright to extend fraud prevention and AML compliance across its global spend management platform.


Payhawk brings corporate cards, expenses, business travel, accounts payable, procurement, global payments, and enterprise controls into one finance platform. As activity moves across cards, accounts, suppliers, entities, currencies, and markets, fraud and AML teams need a consistent way to identify suspicious behaviour, screen relevant parties, and respond without slowing legitimate corporate spend.


> “Fraud and AML risk increasingly intersect across cards, accounts, suppliers, and payments,” said Thibaud Catry, Group Chief Compliance Officer at Payhawk. “In most finance stacks those controls sit in separate systems. With Flagright, we now monitor every payment type against the same logic, across every market we operate in, as Payhawk continues to scale.”


## What the deployment covers


- Monitor approved card, account, and payment activity[in real time with configurable controls](https://www.flagright.com/transaction-monitoring)
- [Screen customers and relevant counterparties](https://www.flagright.com/watchlist-screening) against sanctions, PEP, and other applicable watchlists
- Adapt monitoring logic across entities, products, markets, and transaction patterns
- Support[consistent review and escalation](https://www.flagright.com/case-management) across fraud and AML operations
- Maintain clear evidence and audit ready decision trails


> “Payhawk has built an enterprise operating layer for global corporate spend,” said Baran Özkan, Co founder and CEO of Flagright. “Protecting that environment requires fraud prevention and AML compliance to work from connected signals and controls, rather than separate systems. Flagright gives Payhawk a real time, configurable financial crime compliance layer that can evolve across cards, accounts, suppliers, entities, and payment activity.”


## **About Payhawk**


Payhawk is an AI-native spend management platform that orchestrates global money across Bills, Cards, Expenses, Travel, and Procurement for maximum control, automation and savings. It provides a global money account on top of your ERP combined with agents enforcing rules, policies, and budgets on every payment while giving employees an effortless spending experience. Headquartered in London with offices across Europe and the US, Payhawk serves mid-market and enterprise companies in 32+ countries.


## **About Flagright**


Flagright is the AI operating system for financial crime compliance, trusted by banks, fintechs, and financial institutions in 30+ countries. The platform unifies transaction monitoring, watchlist screening, risk scoring, case management, investigations, reporting, governance, and AI agents in one configurable, audit ready system.
